articles.summary: TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL), a world leader in connectors and sensors, is investing more than $60 million in an advanced research and development and manufacturing facility in New York State for next generation fiber optic solutions engineered to serve hyperscale AI data center operators and cloud providers. The 135,000 square foot facility will accelerate the development and production of TE's high-density fiber array units recently acquired from RAM Photonics designed to enable data center operators to transition to higher-density, lower-power architectures that are essential for the future of AI and cloud computing. TE's technology helps solve critical bottlenecks around performance, density and scalability of fiber attachment for co-packaged optics. "This investment strengthens our capabilities in optics and complements our copper portfolio, enabling us to provide a range of signal connectivity solutions that are vital to enabling next-generation data centers," said TE CEO
articles.title: TE Connectivity invests in New York State R&D and manufacturing facility to develop next-generation optical connectivity products
